stv_lede: {seats} seats. A candidate who reaches the quota of {quota} votes is elected. At each later count, the surplus of a winner, or the votes of the last-placed candidate, moves to the next preference on each ballot.
stv_quota_derived: The source doesn't print the quota, so we calculated it with the Droop formula: valid first preferences divided by seats plus one, rounded down, plus one.
ams_title: How the list seats were allocated
ams_lede: {seats} list seats. Each party's list votes are divided by one more than the seats it already holds in the region, counting constituencies won. Each seat goes to the highest result in turn (D'Hondt method).
ams_reproduced: This calculation reproduces the declared result.
ams_differs: This calculation doesn't reproduce the declared result ({parties}). The declared seats stand.
ams_uncounted: List votes for this region aren't loaded, so the allocation can't be recalculated. Seats are shown as declared.
ams_next: The next seat would have gone to {party}, with {quotient}.
term_quotient: A party's list votes divided by one more than the seats it held before this seat. The highest result takes the seat.
stv_elected_short: Elected at the last count without reaching the quota
declared_tacit: Returned unopposed, so no vote was held.
declared_show_of_hands: Decided by a show of hands, so there is no vote count.
declared_appointed: Filled by appointment, so no vote was held.
declared_counted: Official source lists only the winner, not vote counts.

change_title: Change in percentage points from {from} to {to}

lede_changed: {first} led by {firstMargin} points in {from}; {second} led by {secondMargin} in {to}.
quality_exact_detail: Both elections report results for exactly this area, so every figure compares like with like.
quality_estimated_detail: At least one election is re-aggregated onto this area, so its figures are estimates.
match_party_detail: One row per party, following renamed and merged parties across years.
match_family_detail: One row per party family, so allied and successor parties count together.
shift_title: Change in the margin between {first} and {second} from {from} to {to}
series_gap: No elections held in this seat between {from} and {to}
term_valid: Ballots counted for a candidate, party, or answer. Blank and spoiled ballots are excluded.
term_list_votes: Votes cast for a party's list, which determine how seats are shared among parties.
term_electoral_votes: Votes cast by presidential electors. A candidate wins by receiving a majority of appointed electors.
term_state_delegate_equivalents: The weighted delegate count a caucus reports instead of votes.
term_options: Candidates, parties, or answers with results in this contest.
term_turnout: The share of registered voters who turned out.
term_turnout_rejected: Valid and rejected ballots as a share of the electorate. The source gives no total of ballots cast.
term_turnout_valid: Valid votes as a share of the electorate. The source gives no total of ballots cast or of rejected ballots.
turnout_basis_rejected: Turnout counts valid and rejected ballots.
term_margin: The difference between the leader's share and the runner-up's share, in percentage points.
term_flips: Places led by a different candidate or party in each election.
term_shown: The result set displayed on this page. Other sets are listed for reference.
term_checks: Tests to ensure each place's figures are consistent, such as valid votes never exceeding ballots cast.
term_stage_live: Partial results published while the count is underway.
term_stage_preliminary: An early count published before final checks.
term_stage_official: The count published by the election authority.
term_stage_certified: The final count, formally certified by the election authority.
term_stage_court_revised: A count changed by a court ruling.
term_stage_recount: A count repeated after the initial count.
term_stage_alternative: A count from a source other than the election authority, such as volunteer observers.
term_stage_unreconciled: Sums do not match the official totals. This is listed for reference; the official totals are the result.
term_stage_secondary: Totals come from a secondary source, such as Wikipedia, until the archive loads the official canvass.

regions_lede: Seats won by each party in each {noun}. Select a party to sort by seat count.

versus_pick: Choose a person, place, or party
versus_mismatch: Choose two people, two places, or two parties. You cannot compare different types.
versus_places_none: These two places never voted in the same contest in the archive.
versus_parties_none: These two parties never ran in the same kind of election in the archive.
versus_parties_key: Party vote share, with seats won where recorded.
versus_margin_key: Above the line, {first} led. Below it, {second} led. A dash marks years when the two parties were not the top two.
versus_questions_key: The percentage of 'yes' votes in each place.
versus_head_none: They never ran in the same contest.
versus_shares_lede: Includes every popular vote where either person received votes. Filled marks are wins, hollow marks are losses, and faded marks are primaries. Lines join the first rounds of general elections only.
versus_combined_key: Each place's figure adds up the votes in all of its districts.
governments_lede: The government in office on election day and all governments formed before the next general election.

chamber_makeup_results: Seats each party won at every general election. The dashed line marks a majority. Select a term to view details below.

chamber_plurality: No party held a majority. The largest, {party}, had {seats} of {total} seats.
chamber_no_election: No election record for this term.
chamber_changes_none: No mid-term changes recorded in the archive.
chamber_members_lede: Bars show when each member served during the term. Dates and reasons are shown for those who joined or left partway.
chamber_makeup_mixed: Seats each party held at the start of every term: from records of those who actually sat where available, and from election results otherwise. The dashed line marks a majority. Select a term to view details below.
race_after: After the election, {party} held {seats} of the {total} seats.
race_after_tied: After the election, {party} and {runner} held {seats} of the {total} seats each.

error_429_body: You have made too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

person_lede_advanced_year: Ran in {count} races in {year}, winning {won} and advancing to the next round in {advanced}.
person_ended_appointed: Took an office that vacated the seat
person_elected_note: Bars run from the election won to the next scheduled election, or until the person won another office. The archive does not record specific dates for taking or leaving office.
person_parties_lede: Ran or served under {count} parties between {first} and {last}.
party_strength_lede: Vote share by {noun} for {race} in the {election}. Darker colors show a larger share.
party_strength_missing: No map of the party's vote available for this election.
scrubber_lede: Drag the years or press play to see maps, the elected chamber, and the resulting government.
scrubber_no_map: No map available: the archive has no boundaries for {year}
home_scrub_quiet: No general elections on record this year
home_scrub_hint: Drag the slider to see how the archive grows over time.
map_pick_touch: Tap a place to see its results.
provenance_scan: Digitized from page {page} of {title}. The highlighted box marks the number.
provenance_crop_alt: Scan of page {page} with the number highlighted
provenance_parts: This total is the sum of figures from {count} smaller places, each digitized from a printed page. The first is shown.
provenance_file: This number came from a machine-readable file; no page scan is available.
method_share: Share is the option's votes divided by all valid votes in the same place.
method_seats: Seats are recorded exactly as declared by the authority. The archive does not recalculate them.
method_swing: Swing is the change in the gap between the top two options from one election to the next, in percentage points.
method_stage: When multiple counts exist, the page shows the most final: certified, official, or preliminary.
winners_lede: Shows winners of all {count} races, grouped by {noun}, and the party with the most wins in each.
coverage_current_hint: {year} is still underway, so its contests are left out unless you turn this off.
twin_coverage_current: Counts leave out {year}, which is still underway. Add ?current=1 to include it.
twin_coverage_current_on: Counts include {year}, which is still underway.
coverage_lede: This shows how much of the US election record the archive holds, measured against every contest it should hold. The counts come straight from the database.
coverage_goal_county: Every federal, statewide, and state legislative contest since 2000, primaries and runoffs included, with results by county or finer
coverage_goal_history: Every contest before 2000, including primaries and runoffs: federal and statewide contests from 1824 with results by county, and state legislative contests with district totals
coverage_goal_history_note: Most states printed only district totals for their legislatures before 2000, so that is the goal for those contests. Federal and statewide contests before 1824 are not counted yet.
coverage_goal_turnout: Registered voters and ballots cast for every statewide election day: general elections from 1948; primaries, runoffs, and statewide referendums from 2000
coverage_goal_turnout_note: Before 1948, many states kept no statewide count of registered voters, so earlier elections are not counted yet. North Dakota has had no voter registration since 1951, so its elections need only ballots cast.
coverage_reason_complete_turnout_def: The archive has both the number of registered voters and the number of ballots cast or voters checked in.
coverage_reason_turnout_partial_def: The archive has registered voters or ballots cast, but not both.
coverage_reason_turnout_coarse_def: The archive has only the Census Bureau's survey estimate of registration and voting, not the official counts.
coverage_reason_turnout_absent_def: Election days with no turnout figures in the archive yet.
coverage_part_turnout_recent: Since 2000, every statewide election day: {complete} of {total} ({percent})
coverage_part_national: Federal and statewide, by county: {complete} of {total} ({percent})
coverage_part_legislature: State legislatures, by district total: {complete} of {total} ({percent})
coverage_goal_precinct: Every federal, statewide, and state legislative contest since 2000, primaries and runoffs included, with results by precinct
coverage_goal_local_note: Local governments are sourced from the 2022 Census of Governments. A government is due to vote in the year its election history indicates. If the archive has no election history for a government, the state's usual cycle for that type of government is used.
coverage_goal_shapes: Every federal, statewide, and state legislative contest since 2000 with map shapes for its district and its counties
coverage_goal_shapes_history: Every federal, statewide, and state legislative contest before 2000 with map shapes for its district and its counties
coverage_goal_shapes_note: Precinct shapes are counted in the precinct goal, not here.
coverage_next_hint: These follow the current goal in this order.
coverage_reason_complete_county_def: The archive has results by county, town, or precinct. A district that lies entirely within one county also counts as a county result, since its total is that county's result.
coverage_reason_complete_history_def: Federal and statewide contests have results by county, town, or precinct. State legislative contests have their district's vote counts.
coverage_reason_complete_precinct_def: The archive has results by precinct. Primaries canceled because no one ran against the nominee are included.
coverage_reason_complete_local_def: The archive holds at least one of the government's contests that year.
coverage_reason_complete_shapes_def: The contest's district has a shape for the election date, as does every county, town, or Alaska house district in its results. Statewide contests use the state's shape.
coverage_reason_coarse_def: The archive has results by county or town, but not yet by precinct.
coverage_reason_partial_def: The archive has county or precinct results that cover fewer than 90% of the state's counties or add up to less than the official total.
coverage_reason_totals_def: The archive has the statewide or district total, but no results by county.
coverage_reason_bare_def: The archive lists the contest and its candidates, but it has no vote counts. Most of these are unopposed races.
coverage_reason_absent_def: Contests the election calendar says took place that the archive doesn't have yet.
coverage_reason_absent_local_def: Years a government was due to hold an election that the archive has none of its contests for.
coverage_reason_units_def: The district has a shape, but at least one county, town, or Alaska house district in the results has no shape for the election date.
coverage_reason_unshaped_def: The archive has shapes for the district, but not for the map in use on the election date. Most of these are elections in 2000–2002, which used 1990s maps.
coverage_reason_undrawn_def: The contest has no district, or its district has never had a shape, such as New Hampshire's floterial seats.
coverage_turnout: Turnout is recorded for {count} of the {held} contests the archive holds.
coverage_shapes: Map shapes cover {shaped} of the {precincts} precincts in these results.
coverage_where_hint: Open a state to see its offices, then an office to see its years.
coverage_column_note: Short is the number of contests that do not meet the goal, or election days for turnout and election years for local governments. Bar colors match the legend.
coverage_icpsr_def: Meets the goal, but the only county results come from ICPSR's historical files or from Algara and Amlani's returns compiled from them. Official returns will replace them.
coverage_refresh_requested: Refresh in progress. It takes about 5 minutes.
map_no_results: No results available for this contest
map_unmatched_redrawn_line: Redrawn since {year}. It shares {percent} of its ground with the current version and isn't compared.
map_unmatched_missing_line: No result recorded for this area in {year}, so it isn't compared.
map_estimated_line: Estimated: the {year} result is split from the {year} precincts that overlap this area.
places_others_note: The county source groups {name} with minor candidates; they appear as one group on this map.
seats_up: {count} of {total} seats were up for election. Faded dots represent seats not up.
map_turnout_key: Share of registered voters who cast a ballot
control_none: No overall control: no party won a majority of the {total} seats
control_derived: Worked out from the seats won, since the whole council was up for election.
councils_lede: {count} councils held elections. Control is shown only where the whole council was up, and we work it out from the seats won.
turnout_partial: Based on {reporting} of {of} jurisdictions reporting both registered voters and ballots cast.
map_turnout_change_key: Turnout change since the compared election
